_comment: Beat plan shared by drive.py (capture) and render.py (video). Durations are seconds on screen. Captions must stay factual: everything on the device in mock mode is simulated data. A beat with variants picks its caption from the variant the driver recorded in capture.json.

end.headline: Aegis Pocket

end.note: Recorded on the DevEco HarmonyOS emulator. Requests, agents and numbers are mock data simulated on the device.

footer: DevEco HarmonyOS emulator · HarmonyOS 6.1.1 (API 24) · mock data

beats.title: Posture at a glance
beats.caption: Pending approvals, threats blocked, personal data redacted and budget left. All numbers are mock data simulated on the device.

beats.title: An agent asks
beats.caption: A simulated agent request arrives (mock data). The app posts a local notification and shows an in-app banner.

beats.title: Open it from the shade
beats.caption: Tapping the notification opens that exact request through a WantAgent deep link.

banner.title: Open the request
banner.caption: The request is opened from the app's inbox.

beats.title: Why a human is asked
beats.caption: A 0-100 risk score with plain-language reasons, computed on the phone. The agent's own note is labelled untrusted and never scored.

beats.title: A $50 subscription
beats.caption: This one needs an admin. Acting as Emily (admin); a sponsor can never approve their own agent's request.

beats.title: Step-up before approving
beats.caption: Approve first asks for face, fingerprint or PIN. The emulator has no authenticator, so the app shows its labelled manual fallback.

sheet.caption: Approve first asks for face, fingerprint or PIN through the system authentication sheet. Cancelling approves nothing.

beats.title: Decision recorded
beats.caption: Approved after the manual confirmation; the pending count drops. Denying never asks for authentication.

sheet.caption: Authentication was cancelled, so nothing was approved. Denying never asks for authentication.

beats.title: What data leaves
beats.caption: Synthetic email, PESEL, IBAN and card number become [EMAIL_1], [PESEL_1]... placeholders, checked by checksum, on the phone.

sample.caption: The built-in synthetic sample: email, phone, PESEL, IBAN and card number become [EMAIL_1], [PESEL_1]... placeholders, on the phone.

beats.title: On the home screen
beats.caption: The AI posture widget (MOCK badge) shows what is waiting, updated by the app.
